Next graphics power / 001

Light leaves a trace.

A decayed interior, rain-darkened floor and a tall window being reclaimed by green. Compare the same scene with ray tracing off and on: the ON mode traces visibility rays for shadows, adds reflective paths and a volumetric sun shaft through the dust.

Realtime scene preview
Starting WebGPU renderer…
Requesting a WebGPU device and compiling the room's compute shader. The core renderer uses compute-shader ray tracing, not a proprietary hardware ray-tracing pipeline.
Resolution pendingProcedural geometryWGSL / WebGPU
Ray tracing · ON

Primary intersection rays, ray-tested shadows, a reflective path on wet surfaces, diffuse secondary bounces, and a small volumetric integration pass for window light.

Ray tracing · OFF

The same room, camera, objects and materials using direct-light reference shading. Shadow occlusion, secondary reflections, indirect bounces and the volume pass are disabled.

Why it matters

Lighting becomes a result of scene visibility rather than a painted overlay: geometry can occlude the light, surfaces can reflect the room, and indirect bounces carry subtle color between surfaces.

Source-level control: gpu.roomRaytrace("RoomCanvas", true) · toggle: gpu.setRayTracing(false) · clear samples: gpu.resetRayTracing(). WebGPU needs a supported browser and a secure origin such as HTTPS or localhost.
